verdict.rationale: Mercury documents in-product AI that reads bills, auto-populates payment details, remembers recipients and powers bookkeeping automations, which counts as AI-generated suggestions from the user's data. Its spend-analysis and anomaly-detection skills and its natural-language MCP queries ('Graph my last 6 months of transactions') are first-party, but they run in external AI agents, not inside the Mercury product. missing for 10: an in-app AI insights surface (e.g., spend analysis, anomaly alerts, or a chat assistant inside the dashboard), documentation of insight or recommendation features beyond autofill and automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
